claims.paper_rule: Section2.2: three feature-group Conv1d branches, pooling, many-to-one LSTM and classification head
claims.runtime_rule: Two reduced convolutional autoencoders; 24-to-20-to-10-to-8 branches; configurable LSTM and MLP width

claims.paper_rule: Eq4-9: candidate, input/forget/output gates, cell and hidden-state recursion
claims.runtime_rule: Shared LSTM parameters trained by reverse-mode differentiation through all eight sequence states

claims.paper_rule: Eq11-13: supervised BCE and loss-based training quality proxy
claims.runtime_rule: Natural-log BCE; separately report printed 10^-loss proxy and whether paper quality threshold is met

claims.paper_rule: Section3, Eq15-16: confidence thresholds from risk/reward and margin fraction abs(p-.5)
claims.runtime_rule: Declared theta=.5 thresholds; signed target fraction of current equity; neutral closes inventory

differences: Public BTC/USDT Jan-Jun2024 training, July-September development validation, independent January-March2025 test; prior August-September and October-December negative results retained.
Wavelet denoising, XGBoost feature selection, large indicator grid and dropout are excluded.
Convolutional autoencoders omit the original encoder/decoder pool-upsampling stacks; latent channels are reduced.
Configurable bounded LSTM/FC widths replace original widths20/10; Conv outputs reduced.

Training uses minibatch Adam, training-only standard or MinMax scaler, 12-epoch AE pretraining, frozen encoder/CNN stages and validation checkpoint selection. ReLU replaces the earlier main tanh activation; BatchNorm remains excluded. Bounded stages do not reproduce the paper's convergence loop.
Training quality threshold is reported honestly; runtime pass is not a well-trained or profitable-model assertion.
Printed 10^-BCE proxy uses a different log base from conventional BCE; preserve it as a named paper proxy.
Theta=.5, next-open fills and per-fill costs are declared execution adaptations; no SL/TP bracket engine.
OHLC/price-like features use causal window-relative price normalization; volume uses window mean.
Analytic convolution/LSTM backpropagation matches the independent Scalar autodiff path and finite differences.
Validation influences checkpoint selection only, never gradients or scaler fitting; test is excluded from training request.
Causal 64-bar EMA/Williams and SMA/volatility alternatives were evaluated on development validation but were not selected; this is explicit model selection.
Selected four-unit configuration uses cached frozen-stage features and numerical dot products; original worker time, memory, CPU and imports remain unchanged.
reproduction_scope: bounded local method adaptation; not full paper experiment
